versions.content: Assignment of a Dlt Ecu Identifier to an EcuInstance The EcuInstance is represented in the Log And Trace Extract by the DltEcu that is referenced from the EcuInstance via the aggregated DltConfig in the role dltEcu . The referenced DltEcu defines the ecuId that is transported in the standard header of the log and trace message.
